h:
这是我每天的 Zit 工作流程。我认为一切都通过组旁路程序组织得很好，因此您只需要运行您需要的内容。 Lora Manager 节点和保存节点获取所有相关资源以发布到 Civit，从而省去了手动添加元数据的麻烦。高档的末尾有一个免费的 RAM 功能，因为我注意到我的电脑拿着它哈哈。如果你不介意的话就删除它吧。所有节点都被固定，因为我用手机远程工作，并且厌倦了意外移动垃圾。工作流程中的几个子组用于保存节点，因此您需要打开它们并更改文件名，或者只是将它们完全展开，我喜欢它们，有些人 不。

想不出更多的话可说，但如果您有疑问，请提出，我会尽力提供帮助。

o.en:
This is my daily workflow for Zit. I think everything is pretty well organized with group bypassers so you only need to run what you need. The Lora Manager nodes and save nodes grab all relevant resources for posting to Civit saving the hassle of adding Metadata manually. There is a free Ram function at the end of the upscale because I noticed my pc holding it lol. Just delete it if you dont care. All of the nodes are pinned because I remote in from work on my phone and got sick of accidentally moving shit around. The couple of subgroups that are in the Workflow are for the save nodes so you will want to open them up and change your file names, or just expand them altogether, I like em, some people dont.

Can't think of much more to say but if you have questions please ask and I'll try to help as much as I can.
